summary: Fort Technology Inc, a Toronto-based foreign private issuer trading on Nasdaq (FRTT) and TSXV (FORT), filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications notification dated October 13, 2026, of non-compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The closing bid price stayed below $1.00 for the 30 business days from August 31 to October 12, 2026. Nasdaq granted the standard 180-calendar-day cure period to April 12, 2027, requiring a $1.00 bid for at least 10 consecutive business days; a further 180-day period and reverse split are possible. No immediate trading impact; TSXV listing unaffected. Watch dilution risk from a reverse split.
